scope: IR caches of splits A, B and E only (the verifier never reads the held-out split). Counts are raw.

definitions.cr_ts_present: call/result rows with ts not null
definitions.cr_ts_ms: call/result rows whose ts has >= 3 fractional digits (ms or finer)
definitions.cr_ts_frac_digits: call/result rows with a ts, by number of fractional digits
definitions.results_joined: results that are not orphans (a call with the same call_id precedes them; §3.1)
definitions.results_orphan: results with no preceding call of their call_id
definitions.calls_paired: calls with a paired result (first result of that call_id before the next call of that id)
definitions.pairs_distinct_stamps: paired calls where call and result both carry ts and neither is ts_kind 'shared_turn'
definitions.request_id_eligible_rows: rows of kind assistant/call/meta (where §4.3 looks for request_id)
definitions.request_id_rows: eligible rows with request_id not null
definitions.request_id_distinct: distinct request ids per session, summed over sessions
definitions.request_id_decodable: of those, decodable by verifier.session.decode (DA20 gate)
definitions.request_id_families: distinct request ids per session by id family (verifier.session.id_family), summed
definitions.api_msg_id_distinct_provider: distinct non-synthetic api_msg_ids per session, summed
definitions.api_msg_id_families: distinct non-synthetic api_msg_ids per session by id family, summed
definitions.usage_io_rows: rows with usage_in and usage_out not null
definitions.responses_with_usage: distinct (session_id, api_msg_id) over rows with usage_in not null (ir.py USAGE DEDUPE)
definitions.results_trunc_marker: results with a loss-type truncation marker (A3 catalogue) or the swechat dataset cap
definitions.results_trunc_any: results with a truncation marker or flag
definitions.causal_uuid_rows: rows with uuid and parent_uuid not null
definitions.sessions_with: sessions where the §4.3 capability holds (verifier.session.detect_capabilities, no sidecar)
